sections.title: 2026 World Cup tournament
sections.description: International-style competition through the Engineering Society's 2026 campus tournament. The final showcased the energy and competition that define student sport at MUN.

entries.notes: Japan defeated Colombia in the final to cap a strong tournament run and claim the 2026 Engineering Society World Cup title.
